department: Doctoral School Mechanical, Energy and Materials Engineering (SMEMAG)

deadline.value: The 2026 candidate applications closed on 21 April 2026; 2027 dates are not published.

gre_subject.value: No GRE rule is stated on the school page checked.

supervisor.value: Candidates apply to thesis subjects posted by supervisors, and each subject goes to one candidate.
supervisor.quote: A thesis supervisor may present several subjects, but may only present one candidate per subject

funding.value: The main institutional contract route is a competition, while other funding comes through supervisors' calls.
funding.quote: competition aims to finance doctoral candidates through institutional doctoral contracts

entry_route.value: A master's or equivalent degree is needed to start a PhD in initial training.
entry_route.quote: Registration in initial training is possible as a continuation of a master or other equivalent degree

notes: Umbrella school for mechanical engineering and materials; the page's dates are for the 2026 competition.
